term.label: sequence_variant_causing_no_change_of_translational_product

definition.text: The sequence variant at RNA level does not lead to any change in polypeptide.

comments: OBSOLETE: This term was deleted as it conflated more than one term. The alteration is separate from the effect. Also, as there is no change, this is not a good ontological term.

synonyms.value: sequence variant causing no change of translational product
mutation causing no change of translational product
